---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=./_extensions/qti/schema/qti.schema.json
title: Fractions quiz
format: qti-docbook
qti:
  identifier: FRACTIONS_QUIZ
  title: "Fractions & decimals"
  questions:
    - type: choice
      identifier: ADD_FRACTIONS
      title: "Adding fractions"
      prompt: "What is 1/2 + 1/4?"
      choices:
        - identifier: A
          text: 1/4
        - identifier: B
          text: 3/4
          correct: true
        - identifier: C
          text: "1"
    - type: text_entry
      identifier: HALF_AS_DECIMAL
      title: "Fraction to decimal"
      prompt: "Write 1/2 as a decimal:"
      correct: "0.5"
    - type: choice
      identifier: COMPARE
      prompt: "Which statement is true?"
      choices:
        - text: "1/3 < 1/2"
          correct: true
        - text: "1/3 > 1/2"
---
